options.vibrants_visuals.volumetricFog.t: Height-based fog that scatters sun and moon light, like in Bedrock Edition.
options.vibrants_visuals.lightShafts.too: Rays of light coming from the sun and moon through gaps in terrain.
options.vibrants_visuals.bloom.tooltip: Bright areas glow softly into their surroundings.
options.vibrants_visuals.toneMapping.too: Filmic color grading for richer, more vibrant colors.
options.vibrants_visuals.shadows.tooltip: Directional pixel-aligned shadows cast by the sun and moon.
options.vibrants_visuals.cloudShadows.to: Clouds cast moving shadows on the ground when Vibrants Visuals shadows are on.
options.vibrants_visuals.caustics.toolti: Animated light patterns cast by the sun through water on underwater surfaces.
options.vibrants_visuals.heldLight.toolt: Light sources held in hand light up their surroundings. Items can be added with the vibrants-visuals:held_light_sources item tag.
options.vibrants_visuals.dynamicLight.to: Nearby light sources such as lanterns cast shadows.
options.vibrants_visuals.coloredLight.to: Light sources tint their light: redstone torches glow red, soul fire blue, and stained glass colors light passing through it.
